text: RFP seeks an implementation partner to deploy and integrate Oracle ERP and Utility Billing solutions for the City

citations.text: The purpose of this request for proposal (RFP) is to invite qualified implementation partners to submit a proposal for the deployment and integration of Oracle's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Utility Billing solutions for the City of Durham in North Carolina (the City).
This RFP outlines the City’s specific requirements regarding the implementation, customization, and operational integration of the Oracle solution.
This RFP focuses exclusively on seeking a partner for the implementation phase.

text: The City's goals include integrating business processes, providing consistent corporate data, and producing timely reports

citations.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
citations.text: To support the City’s strategic direction, a solution must have the ability to produce efficient and timely reports to internal and external stakeholders, to integrate business processes, and to provide consistent corporate data across various users in multiple departments including the Finance Department, Budget & Management Services Department, The Customer Billing Services Division within the Department of Water Management, and Human Resources.

text: The City has multiple unintegrated systems, manual processes, and limited reporting; it seeks a single reliable source of information
